title: Rams, Puka Nacua are on the clock for a new deal

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rams, Puka Nacua are on the clock for a new deal
sources.description: The player most immediately impacted by the new Jaxon Smith-Njigba contract is Cowboys receiver George Pickens, who has seen the bar for his next deal move to at least $42.15 million per year — even though he's boxed in by the $27.298 million franchise tag.
